note: Howard County Conservation park on 54-acre Lake Hendricks north of Riceville, the county's largest and most popular park. The lower campground fills a lawn peninsula on the lake's west side; the upper campground is in woods west of the creek. Unsupervised sand swim beach, fishing jetty, boat ramp (electric motors only), trails, softball diamond, playground; the Wapsi-Great Western Line Trail runs through the park. A ranger lives on site year-round. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (county camping page), 80 sites, showers, flush toilets, FCFS self-register, May-October. Lake is 54 acres (note said 50). Lakefront stands for the lower campground's east row; the upper campground is wooded and ~150 m+ from the lake.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront stands (mixed campground). Imagery: the lower campground is a grid of ~40+ gravel back-ins on a peninsula on the lake's west shore. Its east row (~5-6 pads at about 43.3732-43.3736,-92.5481) faces the lake across 25-35 m of open, unused mown lawn with scattered trees and no road or drive between (the lane is behind the pads); the north row is 30-45 m back with a tree clump in front. The swim beach is south of the campground, not between these pads and the water. The upper campground (~43.3745,-92.5510) is in woods west of the creek, ~150 m+ from the lake and not waterfront. The county's campground photo, taken across the lake, shows the beach and shelters with gravel pads on open lawn behind.

HOOKUPS: the county says only 'sites with electricity, water'; no amperage and no electric-site count are posted. The stored electric 30 / water true (derived from old note prose) and the note's '50 water/electric' were not confirmed; left as they are, and the count was dropped from the note.
PIN OK (in the lower campground). Website and ranger phone (641) 985-2127 confirmed.
